episodes.title: Part One: Master and Apprentice
episodes.summary: A valuable prisoner escapes New Republic custody; a search for answers reunites two old friends.

episodes.title: Part Two: Toil and Trouble
episodes.summary: Ahsoka and General Hera Syndulla travel to New Republic shipyards and make an unexpected discovery.

episodes.title: Part Three: Time to Fly
episodes.summary: Hera tangles with New Republic politics while Ahsoka and Sabine Wren voyage to a distant planet.

episodes.title: Part Four: Fallen Jedi
episodes.summary: Hera risks her career to help her friends while Ahsoka and Sabine confront enemies.

episodes.title: Part Five: Shadow Warrior
episodes.summary: Ahsoka confronts her past, while Hera and her allies undertake a rescue mission.

episodes.title: Part Six: Far, Far Away
episodes.summary: The search for Grand Admiral Thrawn reaches beyond the limits of the galaxy.

episodes.title: Part Seven: Dreams and Madness
episodes.summary: Hera must answer to the New Republic, while far, far away, a reunion takes place.

episodes.title: Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord
episodes.summary: The heroes race to prevent Grand Admiral Thrawn's escape.
